remarks: Bright and well-maintained first-floor unit in East Norwalk featuring one bedroom, an eat-in kitchen, a spacious living room, and a full bathroom-all with no carpet (hardwood flooring) throughout. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, on-site parking, and an unbeatable location just minutes from the East Norwalk train station, I-95, SONO, Veterans Park, and Calf Pasture Beach. Walk to the water and enjoy all that this vibrant coastal area has to offer. Water is included; tenants are responsible for paying for gas, electricity, cable, and internet. No pets and no smoking.
